Name: Generate Documentation
Notes: Generate comprehensive documentation in markdown and HTML formats from EA model files. Include diagrams quality reports and breadcrumb navigation.

Name: Extract Model Data
Notes: Extract all model elements from .qea SQLite database including use cases state machines components classes and requirements. Resolve relationships and clean text content.

Name: Render Diagrams
Notes: Render UML diagrams as PNG images using PIL/Pillow. Support use case class component and state machine diagrams with proper UML notation.

Name: Generate HTML Output
Notes: Convert markdown documentation to HTML with embedded CSS and responsive design. Ensure images scale properly on all screen sizes.

Name: Track Documentation Changes
Notes: Track changes between documentation versions. Create snapshots compare versions and generate diff reports with visual markup.

Name: Analyze Documentation Quality
Notes: Analyze model quality and documentation completeness. Identify undocumented elements and calculate coverage metrics.

Name: Extract EA Diagrams
Notes: Extract diagrams directly from EA using Windows COM automation. Export in GUID-timestamp format for pixel-perfect accuracy.

Name: Configure Documentation Options
Notes: Configure documentation generation options via YAML config file or CLI arguments. Support output directories template paths and quality settings.

Name: Run Regression Tests
Notes: Run regression tests to verify documentation consistency. Compare generated output with golden baseline using checksums.

Name: Generate Quality Reports
Notes: Generate quality and dependency reports. Show undocumented elements coverage statistics and dependency graphs.

Name: Software Developer
Notes: Creates and maintains UML models in Enterprise Architect. Runs documentation generator and reviews output.

Name: Technical Writer
Notes: Produces technical documentation for stakeholders. Uses GUI to export EA models to documentation formats.

Name: Project Manager
Notes: Oversees project documentation and quality. Reviews quality reports and tracks documentation changes.

Name: CI/CD System
Notes: Automated documentation generation in build pipeline. Executes command-line tool and validates output.

Name: Enterprise Architect Application
Notes: Source of UML model data. Provides .qea database files and exports diagrams via COM automation.
